abstract: Evolving Business. We all know the story. The multiplication of ways to consume media (e.g., on the web, your mobile, tablets, phablets, glasses, or watches and, of course, on your big screen in the living room) asks for new ways of creating those multiple and derived media products.

authors.bio: Felix Poulin is senior project manager of multi-disciplinary work groups related to media production networks and storage at the EBU Technology and Innovation in Switzerland. — Poulin has “grown up” in studios as his parents worked in TV production. His inherited curiosity for technology led him to a diploma in electrical engineering at the École Polytechnique de Montréal completed by a research project at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. After graduating, he began work as a wireless and digital audio expert on international productions, including at Cirque du Soleil. Before joining the EBU, he worked for national broadcaster CBC/Radio-Canada as engineer in Radio-TV production technologies. — Poulin is a member of SMPTE and co-chair of the Joint EBU/SMPTE/VSF Task Force on Networked Media.
